extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax due
extracted.summary: An executor of his late mother's estate, mostly a house in Bath worth about £693,000, seeks around £26,000 to pay inheritance tax before the grant of probate can be issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding the inheritance tax on your late mother's estate. We have noted that the estate is largely the property in Bath valued at around £693,000, that approximately £26,000 of inheritance tax is payable, and that Beckford Solicitors LLP are instructed. To take this further we would need a copy of the will and details of the executors, a schedule of the estate's assets and liabilities, the property valuation, confirmation of the IHT figure and any payment date, and your solicitors' details so we can liaise with them directly. Once we have those documents a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you; nothing in this message should be taken as an offer or an indication of terms.
